title: 4V1 Passing Through Triangles
setup: 12X25 yard area. 4 attackers vs 1 defender. Variation: 4 vs 2
instructions: The attackers possess the ball and score by passing through the triangles.
The defender scores by dribbling through the triangles.
coachingPoints: Apply the cycle of possession to keep the ball.
Three attackers should surround one triangle to attract the defender.
Then they should pass to the far target player and quickly run to provide short passing options.
The faster you play the far target player the more time and space you will have to score through the triangle.
Don't force the play when the defender is near.
